node.statement: Same-chart retention: from U=sJ bold-dot(J+A+G(A)), the involution and product estimate give ||U^dagger-sJ||<=(1+epsilon_r)(1+d)||A||. Therefore the explicit closeness estimate gives ||W-sJ||<=(1+epsilon_r)(1+C_ch*(epsilon_r+delta))*r+C_grp*epsilon_r<2delta. Since L_{sJ}=sI exactly, C=phi_{sJ}(W)=s(W-sJ) has norm below 2delta; its Hermitian and anti-Hermitian projections are contractive because dagger is isometric. Write B=C^par. Unitarity of W and W=sJ bold-dot(J+C) imply f_{sJ}(C)=0, so uniqueness in lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control forces C^perp=G(B). Hence W=chi_s(B) in the same sJ graph chart, B=F_s(A), and these coordinate maps are C1.
